overview_description.description:
TouchandPay Technologies provides payment and transaction services using simple technology. By leveraging the use of NFC (Near Field Communication) technology, they integrate digital technology services to help communicate ideas, products, services, and information through end-to-end business solutions from ideation, prototyping, production, quality checking, product launches, and maintenance. The platform provides full visibility into all transactions performed through a unique and robust dashboard and reporting backend system. 

Simple NFC technology helps to solve various problems faced by business owners ranging from small to large organizations, such as product aggregation to payment settlement, ensuring a seamless flow among the players and thus making the market more appealing and efficient.
